title: Mother in Bikini with Baby and Dog in Backyard, 1950s Snapshot Photo
description: A charming mid-century black-and-white outdoor snapshot showing a young mother in a gathered halter two-piece swimsuit seated in a sunny backyard. In front of her, an infant baby rests on a white blanket while a friendly small dog sniffs near the baby, gently petted by the mother. A classic white picket fence and residential garage frame the background, evoking 1950s post-war American suburban family life and warm-weather leisure.
